input.context: Lanes add independent proof modules under tests/proofs. The default suite must discover that directory while container-only and maintainer-only tests use registered markers.

excerpts.text:
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests/repo", "tests/proofs/test_thin_slice.py", "tests/proofs/test_exit_engine.py", "tests/proofs/test_claude_shelf.py", "tests/proofs/test_workflows.py", "tests/proofs/test_candidate_history.py", "tests/proofs/test_exit_study_41.py", "tests/proofs/test_research_sources.py", "tests/proofs/test_options_jev.py", "tests/proofs/test_replay.py", "tests/proofs/test_reentry.py", "tests/proofs/test_sharadar_coverage.py"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
addopts = "-q"

[tool.pyright]
include = ["src", "tests"]
ignore = ["src/sextant/strategies/ema_cross.py", "src/sextant/research/b_exit_replay.py"]
pythonVersion = "3.13"
typeCheckingMode = "standard"

defects.claim: Enumerating individual proof files in testpaths silently omits newly added proofs from the default suite.
